messages:
Noah Kim: FYI team we observed ingestion failures for the new onboarding pipeline between 11:051:18 UTC. Impact: ~9 trial tenants and 2 POCs. Error surfaced as tokenizer mismatch after the A/B tokenizer rollout.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2024-578 logged: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2024-578 :rotating_light:
Priya Shah: thanks Noah. any customer-visible data loss or just failed requests?
Diego Morales: rollback to tokenizer v1.8.1 at 11:12 stopped further failures. No persisted data loss detected, but ~40 upload requests returned 5xx and did not enqueue. We saved request IDs for retries.
Rachel Lee: pulled affected tenant list and flagged 3 as high churn/renewal risk (T-452, T-459, T-466). Recommend AE touch within 4 hours.
Tom Becker: Agreed. I'll ping AEs and include a warm handoff note + offer a 30min troubleshooting office hour this week.
Noah Kim: Draft outbound for affected trials (short + CTA):
Noah Kim: "Hi <Customer Name>,
Between 11:051:18 UTC we experienced transient ingestion errors that may have prevented some documents from being processed into your trial instance. We rolled back the change and retried confirmed uploads; if you notice missing items, reply and we'll re-run immediately. We've applied a 14-day pro-rata credit to your account and can schedule a 1:1 troubleshooting session. You can verify imports at Console > Onboarding > Import History.
Thanks, Redwood Customer Success"
Priya Shah: draft is good. can we add a short FAQ entry to paste into messages: 1) Why did this happen? 2) How to verify? 3) What we did to fix?
Diego Morales: FAQ snippet: "Q: Why did uploads fail? A: A recent tokenizer update introduced an edge-case that caused certain payloads to error during preprocessing. Q: Is my data safe? A: Yes no data was deleted; failed requests were dropped and are eligible for retry. Q: What next? A: We rolled back the tokenizer change, queued retries for confirmed requests, and will provide credits for impacted trials."
Rachel Lee: For the 3 renewal-risk tenants, propose we: 1) AE ping + personalized note, 2) schedule a 30min troubleshooting + roadmap sync, 3) apply priority retry and confirm within 2 hours.
Tom Becker: I'll coordinate the AE messages and paste each sent message here.
Noah Kim: Engineering, what's ETA for completing retries for the high-priority tenants?
Diego Morales: ETA: high-priority retries within 90 minutes (jobs: retry-job-881, retry-job-882), bulk retries over next 6 hours (bulk-job-458). We'll stream progress to INC-2024-578.
Priya Shah: Action items: 1) Tom/AE send targeted outreach to the 3 renewal-risk tenants within 1 hour; 2) Rachel confirm credits applied; 3) Diego run priority retries and post job IDs; 4) Noah send the broader trial status at 12:00 UTC.
Tom Becker: Starting AE outreach now. Pasting one example when sent.
Rachel Lee: Credits applied to all affected trials (14-day pro-rata). Posting list in the incident page.
Diego Morales: Started retry-job-881 for T-452 at 11:26 UTC. Will update when finished.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2024-578 status changed to Investigating -> Mitigated at 11:20 UTC.
Noah Kim: Thanks everyone. I'll queue the outbound send at 12:00 UTC and will include the FAQ and a direct link to schedule office hours. Please react when your item is closed.
Tom Becker: AE messages sent for T-452/T-459/T-466, included office hour link and offered to join the retry session.
Priya Shah: marking items complete on my checklist.
Diego Morales: retry-job-881 complete for T-452, imports reprocessed (IDs: 5421, 5422, 5427). Monitoring for errors.
